deadline.value: Applications due before December 15 for fall, all applicants.
deadline.quote: Application materials must be submitted before December 15th (for all applicants).

toefl_min.value: Department requires TOEFL iBT 80 with at least 24 on speaking; higher than the Graduate College minimum.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum aggregate TOEFL score of 80, with a score of at least 24 on the speaking portion, is required for admission.

ielts_min.value: Department requires IELTS composite 7.5 with no band below 6.
ielts_min.quote: An IELTS (International English Language Testing System) minimum composite score of 7.5, with no subject area below a 6.

supervisor.value: Students do three lab rotations in fall before choosing a dissertation advisor.
supervisor.quote: students undertake three laboratory rotations in the Fall semester prior to choosing a dissertation advisor

funding.value: All PhD students in good standing receive an assistantship plus tuition remission and health insurance.
funding.quote: All Ph.D. students in good standing are provided financial support in the form of a teaching or research assistantship.
